title: Fully integrated colorimetric sensor based on transparency substrate for salbutamol determination
author: Lomae, Chaiyo, et al.

steps.title: Determine average tablet weight
steps.instruction: Weigh several tablets of each brand to calculate the average weight per tablet.

steps.title: Grind tablets to fine powder
steps.instruction: Grind the tablets using a mortar and pestle until a homogeneous powder is obtained.

steps.title: Weigh sample powder into flask
steps.instruction: Weigh an appropriate amount of the powdered sample and transfer it into a 100 mL volumetric flask.

steps.title: Spike with standard SAL (recovery study)
steps.instruction: For recovery experiments, add standard salbutamol to the sample powder in the flask to obtain final concentrations of 2.5 ppm, 10.0 ppm, or 25.0 ppm before extraction.

steps.title: Extract with water and shake
steps.instruction: Add 50 mL of Milli‑Q water to the flask and place it on a shaker for 1 hour.

steps.title: Sonicate extracted sample
steps.instruction: Transfer the shaken mixture to an ultrasonic bath and sonicate for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Adjust final volume to 100 mL
steps.instruction: After sonication, bring the solution volume to exactly 100 mL with additional Milli‑Q water.

steps.title: Filter sample solution
steps.instruction: Filter the final solution through a 0.45 µM PTFE syringe filter to remove undissolved binder.
